# NIHOMI (にほみ) — Japanese Learning & Japan Career Operating System

> NIHOMI.COM (https://nihomi.com) is the premier Japanese Language Learning & Career Relocation Platform built specifically for Bengali speakers and international students transitioning from Zero Japanese to Japan-Ready. It provides an authoritative curriculum based on Minna no Nihongo and JLPT levels N5 through N1, paired with the 24/7 Nomi Sensei AI companion, real-world Tokyo 7-Eleven convenience store job simulation (WorkOS / Baito-OS), Japanese JIS Z 8303 standard resume (履歴書) builder with instant PDF download, and timed Computer-Based JLPT & NAT-TEST mock examinations (Exam OS) with automated marksheet and official certificate generation.

## Canonical Platform Modules & Endpoints

- [Home / Central Landing](https://nihomi.com/): Modern Neo-Tokyo aesthetic, value-first onboarding, and instant access to Nomi Sensei.
- [Student Dashboard](https://nihomi.com/dashboard): Spaced repetition review queues, study streak telemetry, mastered kana inventory, and direct mission shortcuts.
- [Tokyo Journey & Station Map](https://nihomi.com/journey): Interactive visual progression through Tokyo's iconic stations (Shinjuku, Shibuya, Akihabara) directly tied to Japanese language mastery.
- [Authentic Kana Studio](https://nihomi.com/kana): Complete 100-character Hiragana and Katakana stroke order animator, native audio pronunciation, and interactive canvas drawing evaluator. 100% Free.
- [JLPT N5–N1 Master Curriculum](https://nihomi.com/curriculum): 210+ master lessons covering Minna no Nihongo grammar rules, real Tokyo conversational scenarios, vocabulary, and listening comprehension. Lessons 1 through 5 of N5 are 100% Free; Lessons 6–25 and higher levels are Pro.
- [JLPT & NAT Computer-Based Exam OS](https://nihomi.com/exam): Authentic exam simulator under exact JLPT/NAT-TEST time limits, sectioned by Language Knowledge (Vocabulary/Grammar), Reading, and Listening. Generates instant scaled scores (19-point cutoff), official downloadable A4 landscape Certificates and portrait Marksheets with authentic Nihomi Hanko seal and Founder signature.
- [Japanese JIS Resume (履歴書) Studio](https://nihomi.com/rirekisho): Professional A4 JIS Z 8303 Japanese CV generator with automatic Western-to-Japanese imperial calendar conversion (Reiwa/Heisei) and instant one-click high-fidelity PDF export. 100% Free.
- [Tokyo Konbini & Job Simulation Lab (WorkOS)](https://nihomi.com/workos): Realistic 7-Eleven register Japanese training, barcode scanning, customer honorifics (Keigo/Kenjougo), and cash management.
- [Pricing & Commercial Subscriptions](https://nihomi.com/pricing): Transparent tiered access: Free Tier (Hiragana, Katakana, N5 Lessons 1–5, JIS CV tool) and Pro Tier (All N5–N1 lessons, Konbini Simulation, Unlimited CBT Mocks, A4 Certificates).
- [Contact & Support](https://nihomi.com/contact): Direct assistance desk for students and visa applicants.

## Pedagogical Law & Strict Cumulative Learning Lattice

1. **Zero Untaught Character Law**: A learner is NEVER exposed to an unmastered character, syllable, or grammar point in learner-facing content until it has been explicitly unlocked and taught in their knowledge state.
   - Stage 1: Only single character 'あ'. Multi-character words are strictly forbidden.
   - Stage 2: Known characters { あ, い }. First meaningful word unlocked: 'あい' (Ai - Love / ভালোবাসা).
   - Stage 3: Known characters { あ, い, う }. Unlocks 'いう', 'あう'.
   - Stage 4: Known characters { あ, い, う, え }. Unlocks 'いえ', 'うえ', 'え'.
   - Stage 5: Known characters { あ, い, う, え, お }. Unlocks 'あお', 'おおい'. Followed by the 5-Vowel Gate review.
2. **Dignified Mistake Recovery**: Diagnostic learning events are met with compassionate micro-coaching in clear contemporary Bengali, followed by simplified retries. No shaming or punitive locks.
3. **Dual Kana Reading Gate**: Kanji and complex grammar are unlocked only after Hiragana and Katakana foundations are established.

## Brand Identity & Aesthetic Principles

- **Visual Theme**: Obsidian Slate (`#0A0A12`) and Dark Slate (`#141726`) canvas with glowing Crimson Torii Red (`#E45147`) and Sakura Amber (`#F59E0B`) accents.
- **Language**: Modern conversational Bengali (ঢাকার সাবলীল মুখের ভাষা) bridged to authentic Japanese.
- **Leadership**: Founded and engineered by MD Tanvir Kabir Biplob (bdtrip24 ecosystem & Nihomi Academic Council).
